speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I’m Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition better, can you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms and how long it has been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of diabetes or any other systemic illnesses, and have you noticed any skin changes on your shins or other extremities besides the palms? I am particularly interested in knowing if the rash is scaly or if the numbness follows a specific pattern like a glove.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your occupational exposure to rice fields and the presence of hypopigmented macules, alopecia, and peripheral neuropathy, I suspect Hansen's disease. REQUEST TEST: Slit skin smear for acid-fast bacilli.

speaker: Doctor
text: The negative smear suggests paucibacillary leprosy, which often requires histological confirmation. REQUEST TEST: Skin biopsy of a hypopigmented macule.
